Hi, I was able to reproduce the issue on 2x NVIDIA A100 80GB PCIe-2.
And can you clarify how precisely you installed JAX? How can I reproduce that exact software config?

## JAX 0.9.2
I can reproduce the issue by installing JAX as follows (this environment is more recent than my original post, but the problem persists):
#### Installation
```
python3.12 -m venv test_env
source test_env/bin/activate
pip install -U "jax[cuda13]"
python3.12 test_script.py
rm -rf test_env
```
#### Environment info
```

jaxlib: 0.9.2
numpy:  2.4.4
python: 3.12.3 (main, Aug 14 2025, 17:47:21) [GCC 13.3.0]
device info: NVIDIA A30-2, 2 local devices"
process_count: 1
platform: uname_result(system='Linux', node='clapper.doc.ic.ac.uk', release='6.14.0-29-generic', version='#29~24.04.1-Ubuntu SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Thu Aug 14 16:52:50 UTC 2', machine='x86_64')
```
To run these scripts, I am submitting jobs to my departments [GPU cluster](https://www.imperial.ac.uk/computing/people/csg/guides/hpcomputing/gpucluster/), requesting either 2xA30 or 2xA100.

## JAX 0.7.2
The same problem occurs in an older version of JAX (0.7.2) with CUDA 12.9.0 using slightly different sharding logic.
#### Installation
```
python3.12 -m venv test_env
source test_env/bin/activate
pip install -U "jax[cuda12]==0.7.2"
python3.12 test_script.py
rm -rf test_env
```
#### Script
```
import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp

jax.print_environment_info()
devices = jax.local_devices()
num_gpus = len(devices)

def put_sharded(x):
    """Shard x across local devices."""
    return jax.device_put_sharded(x, devices)

dim = 16
arrays = [(i + 1) * jnp.ones(shape=(dim,), dtype=jnp.float32) for i in range(num_gpus)]

sharded = put_sharded(arrays)
jax.block_until_ready(sharded)
gathered = jax.device_get(sharded)

gathered = jnp.reshape(gathered, (num_gpus, dim))
for i in range(num_gpus):
    expected = jnp.sum(arrays[i]).item()
    observed = jnp.sum(gathered[i]).item()
    print(f"Expected {expected} | observed {observed}")
```
#### Environment info
```
jax:    0.7.2
jaxlib: 0.7.2
numpy:  2.4.4
python: 3.12.3 (main, Aug 14 2025, 17:47:21) [GCC 13.3.0]
device info: NVIDIA A30-2, 2 local devices"
process_count: 1
platform: uname_result(system='Linux', node='clapper.doc.ic.ac.uk', release='6.14.0-29-generic', version='#29~24.04.1-Ubuntu SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Thu Aug 14 16:52:50 UTC 2', machine='x86_64')
```

issue.body:
### Description

#### Summary
When sharding data across 2 GPUs and then converting back to host, data corresponding to the second GPU is replaced with zeros. This occurs on a multi-GPU NVIDIA A30 setup using JAX 0.9.1. Using 1 GPU and forcing ```--xla_force_host_platform_device_count=2``` results in correct data on both simulated devices.

#### Script to reproduce
```
import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
from jax.sharding import NamedSharding, PartitionSpec as P

devices = jax.local_devices()
num_gpus = len(devices)

mesh = jax.make_mesh((num_gpus,), ('devices'))
sharded_sharding = NamedSharding(mesh, P("devices"))

def put_sharded(x):
    """Shard a list of num_gpus pytrees across local devices."""
    stacked = jax.tree.map(lambda *xs: jnp.stack(xs), *x)
    return jax.device_put(stacked, sharded_sharding)

dim = 16
arrays = [(i + 1) * jnp.ones(shape=(dim,), dtype=jnp.float32) for i in range(num_gpus)]

sharded = put_sharded(arrays)
jax.block_until_ready(sharded)
gathered = jax.device_get(sharded)

for i in range(num_gpus):
    expected = jnp.sum(arrays[i]).item()
    observed = jnp.sum(gathered[i]).item()
    print(f"Expected {expected} | observed {observed}")
```
#### Observed Output
```
Expected 16.0 | observed 16.0
Expected 32.0 | observed 0.0
```
### System info (python version, jaxlib version, accelerator, etc.)

#### Environment info
```
jax:    0.9.1
jaxlib: 0.9.1
numpy:  2.4.3
python: 3.12.3 (main, Aug 14 2025, 17:47:21) [GCC 13.3.0]
device info: NVIDIA A30-2, 2 local devices"
process_count: 1
platform: uname_result(system='Linux', node='clapper.doc.ic.ac.uk', release='6.14.0-29-generic', version='#29~24.04.1-Ubuntu SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Thu Aug 14 16:52:50 UTC 2', machine='x86_64')
```
#### Extra details
```
CUDA Version: 13.0
Driver Version: 580.65.06
```
issue.title: Data loss on device 1 during multi-GPU sharded device_put
